title: All Made of Air
description: An original seven-voice a cappella song. The lead, harmony, answering choir, bass, drums and spoken responses all come from simulated mouths.

melody.name: Lead
melody.lyrics: One voice wakes the room. Two voices make it bloom. Low notes hold the ground. High notes lift the sound. We are made of air. Sing it far and wide. Each voice brings a light. Carry us tonight.
